messages.content: "給定單詞列表 ['apple', 'banana', 'cherry', 'date', 'elderberry']，你能否先使用 'sort_list' 函數將此列表按降序排序？然後，使用 'filter_list' 函數，過濾掉以字母 'b' 開頭的水果？之後，考慮數字列表 [5, 10, 15, 20, 25]。你能否使用 'sum_elements' 函數找出這些數字的總和？最後，再次使用 'sort_list' 函數將數字列表 [35, 10, 25, 5, 15] 按升序排序？"

function.name: sort_list
function.description: Sort the elements of a list in ascending or descending order Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

elements.description: The list of elements to sort.

order.description: The order in which to sort the elements. This can be 'asc' for ascending order, or 'desc' for descending order.

function.name: sum_elements
function.description: Add all elements of a numeric list Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

elements.description: The list of numeric elements to add.

function.name: filter_list
function.description: Filters elements of a list based on a given condition Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

elements.description: The list of elements to filter.

condition.description: The condition to filter the elements on.
